name: Rider
description: A customer who hails and pays for trips through the ECT Rider app.

name: Driver
description: A licensed operator who accepts and completes trips via the ECT Driver app.

name: Trip
description: A single completed journey from pickup to dropoff

name: TLC License
description: The NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission license number that authorizes a driver to operate.

name: Cardholder Data
description: Data elements defined by PCI DSS: Primary Account Number (PAN), cardholder name, and expiry.

name: Trip Survey
description: Rider feedback on a completed trip
synonyms: including a rating and free-text comment.

name: Payout
description: A payment made to a driver for completed trips

name: PII
description: Information that identifies or can identify a specific individual, alone or combined.

name: Sensitive PII
description: PII that, if disclosed, creates significant harm risk (e.g., SSN, background check).

name: Location Data
description: Pickup/dropoff zones which, tied to a rider, reveal a person's movements.

name: Financial Data
description: Data describing fares, payouts, revenue, or financial position.

name: Restricted Data
description: Highest classification: PII, sensitive financial/HR data, cardholder data, regulated IDs, secrets. Strict access control and encryption required.

name: Confidential Data
description: Sensitive business or financial data whose disclosure would harm ECT, a rider, or a driver, but not regulated PII.

name: Internal Data
description: Operational data intended for internal use; low harm if disclosed.

name: Public Data
description: Data approved for public release; no restriction.

name: Data Owner
description: Accountable executive/role for a data domain; approves access and classification.

name: Data Steward
description: Operational role responsible for day-to-day data quality and definitions within a domain.

name: Data Custodian
synonyms: Platform/SRE) that implements storage and controls for the data.
